scope: Independent source review of saved_service_view adapters and their existing profile/file reader dependencies; no runtime/test or full-profile qualification credit.

checks.subject: Missing ambiguity
checks.detail: The existing ConfigFile loader can return Missing when primary is absent but recovery candidates are malformed. The adapter does not accept that result alone: it checks exactly primary/.bak/.saving through the bounded reader. True missing requires all three absent; a present candidate yields InvalidFormat rather than an empty service. Errors and requested cancellation propagate. Confirmation can stop after the first present/error result because absence has already been disproved.

checks.subject: Recovery choice and provenance
checks.detail: No recovery logic is duplicated or broadened. Complete primary wins; absent primary tries saving then backup; malformed primary tries backup then saving. A present primary/candidate read error propagates rather than being silently skipped. Successful snapshot retains exact Primary/Backup/Saving choice. A complete but semantically malformed projection is not silently replaced with another file.

checks.subject: Held lease, allowlist and file safety
checks.detail: Public entry points bind literal tracker.config or sharing.config only. No lease acquisition occurs. Existing lease validity and directory fd are checked by ConfigFile. Candidate reads use directory-relative openat with O_RDONLY/O_CLOEXEC/O_NOFOLLOW/O_NONBLOCK, require regular files and enforce the size cap before allocating. No source-supplied field is used as a pathname. Symlink/special-file/read-change errors remain failures. No scans, metadata joins or cache/path chasing are called.

checks.subject: Bounded input/projection and ownership
checks.detail: Both loading and absence confirmation explicitly use core::Limits{} (4MiB input/string,100000nodes,depth64), rather than the broader192MiB compatible config limits. The reviewed pure projection then enforces its own capped rows/fields/text/issues and owns a private immutable source tree/raw backing, so returned data survives ConfigFile destruction. The two optional fields are set together on success; true missing has neither.

checks.subject: Cancellation and error effects
checks.detail: Stop is checked before and after ConfigFile::load, around every confirmation read and before returning missing, and after projection before publication. Existing IO/unsafe/conflict/format errors propagate; projection limits map to Unsupported, malformed roots/lists/edited documents to InvalidFormat and allocation failure to Io. A requested stop takes precedence when checked. No half-built snapshot is returned.

checks.subject: Readonly boundary
checks.detail: The adapter invokes only load/read/projection operations; it never calls ConfigFile::save, writeExclusive, lease acquire, ordinary Java managers or service startup. It performs no file creation/rename/unlink, directory scan, clock, network access or payload/cache dereference. The caller remains responsible for holding a valid lease throughout this synchronous call.

limits_and_honest_boundaries: Cancellation surrounds ConfigFile::load as one operation; that existing loader can read and parse up to three bounded files before the next stop check. It does not interrupt a blocking read or parser mid-operation.
Separate candidate reads are not an atomic transaction against external changes. Missing means all three were individually observed absent; it does not establish simultaneous absence.
Existing file reader detects size/mtime changes on its opened descriptor, not every possible concurrent path replacement or same-size metadata-preserving edit; no stronger guarantee is added here.

These functions report saved/offline records and recovery provenance. They establish no live tracker/share state, full manager restore behavior, write compatibility, service startup or permission to open saved paths.
separate_generated_tests_to_confirm: All absent versus empty valid list versus absent primary with malformed backup/saving; a present empty file must not become Missing.
Exact primary/backup/saving preference and propagation of symlink, special-file, oversize and read failures without writes.
Already requested cancellation, invalid/moved lease, successful ownership after local ConfigFile destruction and unchanged unknown raw source bytes.
Default core input cap rather than broad compatibleConfigLimits; malformed semantic root/list/field and projection-limit error mappings.

performed: Complete reads of new adapter header/source and existing profile/file_io header/source
Read unchanged prior core source review and checked stable input SHA256 values before/after inspection
not_performed: No builds, tests or target imports
No live profile/filesystem probes, app/process/port inspection
No Java/native/service execution or manager equivalence comparison

changed_files: Only this new review JSON; no production, tests, CMake, plan or prior evidence changes.
